reason: The cited evidence (E2, E3) directly supports all key premises: it reports isolated Pt/Pd sites from low-temperature synthesis, charge transfer to Pt/Pd via XPS/DFT, stronger nitrobenzene interaction via DRIFTS, and higher aniline yield for the HEA vs. PtPd.
